pass_rule: PASS only if the same frozen context-8 companded arm has ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all 11 splits in all 3 fresh replicates (33/33 cells).
interpretation: One frozen 18-bit causal companded representation plus one generic context-8, 16-feature ridge identifier beat raw-state persistence on every registered ID/OOD cell across wave, Gray-Scott and cubic NLS. No law-family router, family label, hidden dynamics parameter, or known equation/integrator was supplied to the identifier. The representation was fit only on wave+Gray data; NLS remained absent from representation training. This strengthens the evidence that the same discrete observation and context-identification recipe can transfer across these three synthetic PDE families under the tested regimes.
limitations: All three families are known synthetic PDEs and all successful laws lie within the hand-specified generic local spatial+cubic feature library. This stage does not test laws outside that hypothesis class and therefore does not demonstrate unrestricted equation discovery or a universal scientific tokenizer.
claim_limit: No novel-physics, AGI, SSI, or universal-law-discovery claim.
